5. The victim test needs `file_type` to be a valid configuration variable so that when `allowed_types` is checked, the key exists and the type check can proceed (and fail with `TypeError` as expected).

The fix is to set up the required `FILE_TYPE` environment variable at the start of the victim test, then clean it up at the end.
